questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appreciate option. If a sentence is free from error, select ‘No Error’.**

The Government should deploy an adequate (1)/ number of security personnel to maintain law or (2)/ order during the next fortnight at the holy place. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution: The error lies in part 2 of the sentence as the preposition 'or' is incorrect and must be replaced with 'and' as 'law and order' is the correct phrase. It means 'a situation characterized by respect for and obedience to the rules of a society.' It should read as:'number of security personnel to maintain law and..'

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option.**

Aviation is important, both as an industry in its own right and as a facilitator for the (1)/ success and competitiveness of other industries. The success of the aviation industry (2)/ is also integral to national competition, economic developing and social progress. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution: The error lies in part 3 of the sentence as the word 'developing' is incorrect here and should be replaced with the noun 'development'. It should read as:'is also integral to national competition, economic development and social progress.'development is a noun.

questions.question:

questions.question:

**Statements: **

I. No circle is square.

II. Some squares are rectangle

**Conclusions: **

I. Some circles are rectangle

II. No circle is rectangle
questions.solution:

II. No circle is rectangle → False (It is possible but not defined).

But, coclusion I and II makes a complimentary pair.

Hence, either conclusion (I) or conclusion (II) follows.

questions.question: Rahul is 6 years younger than his elder brother Shyam. Rahul also has a sister who is 4 years younger to him. What is the difference between the age of Rahul and the average age of the three siblings?
questions.solution:
Let, Rahul's age = x

∴ Rahul's brothers age = x + 6

∴ Rahul's sister's age = x - 4

∴ Their total age = (x + x + 6 + x - 4) = 3x + 2

∴ Their average age = (3x + 2)/3 = x + 2/3

Required difference,

⇒ (x + 2/3) - x

⇒ 2/3 year = 8 months

questions.question: Reshma bought a showpiece for Rs. 731 with a discount of 14% on the marked price. Find the marked price of the showpiece.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 731

Discount = 14%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP – Discount

Where, SP = Selling Price

CP = Cost Price

**Calculation:**

Let Marked price (MP) of showpiece be Rs. x

According to the question:

⇒ Discount = 14% of x = Rs. 0.14x

Now,

SP = MP – Discount

⇒ SP = x – 0.14x

⇒ 731 = 0.86x

⇒ x = 731/0.86 = 850

**∴ Marked Price of showpiece is Rs. 850.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

Let, marked price = x

According to problem,

⇒ x - x × 14/100 = 731

⇒ 0.86x = 731

⇒ x = 850

∴ Marked Price of showpiece is Rs. 850.

questions.question: X can do a piece of work in 15 hours. He works at it for 5 hours and then Y finishes the work in 5 hours. How long will they together take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
X can do a work in = 15 hours

∴ In 1 hour X can do = 1/15

∴ In 5 hours X can do = 5/15 = 1/3

∴Remaining work = 1 – 1/3 = 2/3

In 5 hours y can do = 2/3

∴In 1 hour Y can do = 2/15

Let, they together complete the work in = a hour

According to the problem,

 Rightarrow a( {(1)/({15)} + (2)/({15)}} ) = 1

 Rightarrow a( {frac{{1 + 2}}{{15}}} ) = 1

 Rightarrow a ( {(3)/({15)}} ) = 1

 Rightarrow a = frac{{15}}{3}

 Rightarrow a = 5

∴ They together complete the work in 5 hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the total work be the 15 units

Efficiency of X = 15/15 = 1 unit/day

X work for 5 hours and completed work = 1 × 5 = 5 units

Remaining = 15 - 5 = 10 units

Y finishes the remaining work with efficiency = 10/5 = 2 units/day

∴ Together can complete the work in time = 15/(2 + 1) = 5 hours

questions.question: The “Atal Pension Yojana” (APS) is a scheme which focuses on workers in the ________.
questions.solution:

questions.question: Which one of the following longitude determines the Indian Standard Time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **82.5° E**.

 
• The standard time observed throughout India known as the Indian Standard Time is determined based on the 82.5°E longitude.
 
• The longitude passes through **Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The Indian Standard Time is 5 hrs 30 mins ahead of Greenwich Mean Time.

questions.question: Where is the Garampani Sanctuary located?

questions.question: Heavy water is ________.
questions.solution:
__

questions.question: What is laughing gas?
questions.solution:
• Laughing gas, chemically known as nitrous oxide is an anesthetic gas, that is, it induces loss of consciousness.
 
• It is named so because the euphoric effects of the gas sometimes make people laugh uncontrollably.

questions.question: When a ring of metal is heated, what happens to its hole?

options.text: Expands or contracts according to its diameter
Expands or contracts according to its coefficient of expansion

questions.solution:
• When a **ring of metal is heated**, the **hole in the ring expands** due to the expansion of the metal.
 
• This is because heat supplies energy to the molecules of the metal which then begin to vibrate and move away from each other which in turn leads to an increase in the surface area of the metal.
 
• This expansion of the metal causes the diameter of the hole to increase too.

questions.question: Where is the pituitary gland located?
questions.solution:
• The **pituitary gland** is a gland which is located at the base of the **brain**, right behind the bridge of the nose.
 
• It is a small, hormone-producing gland(endocrine) whose secretions are essential for everyday living.
 
• It is also known as the master gland as its secretions stimulate other glands.

questions.question: How does pollination take place in maize?
questions.solution:
• Pollination in maize occurs through the wind. This is because the pollen is light and can be easily carried by wind from the anther to the stigma.
 
• Pollination is a process which involves the transfer of pollen from the anther of one plant to the stigma of another plant or the same plant.
 
• This process is essential for fertilization and production of seeds.

questions.question: Who was awarded with the Nobel Prize for Literature in 2016?

questions.question: Which of the following sectors contributes most to the savings in India?
questions.solution:
• The household sector is the major and largest contributor to savings in India.
 
• Savings are mainly affected by three sectors- household sector, private corporate sector, andpublic sector. Out of these, the household sector contributes about 70% to the gross savings.
 
• Savings can be computed by subtracting the expenditure in a given year from the GDP(gross domestic product) of the same year.

questions.question: Which Governor General introduced the Permanent Settlement of Revenue in Bengal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Lord Cornwallis**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1793, the Permanent Settlement of Revenue in Bengal was introduced by Lord Cornwallis.
 
• Permanent settlement was an agreement between the landlords(zamindars) and the East India Company.
 
• This settlement gave primary ownership of the land to the zamindars and fixed the revenue amount payable to the company

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Extra facts:

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
__Governor-General __

 
 
 
__Events or Achievements__

 
 
 

 
 
Robert Clive 

 
 
 
Clive served twice as Governor of Bengal (1758-60 and 1764-67).

 
The Dual System of Government in Bengal was introduced by Lord Clive.

 
British East India Company won the Battle of Plassey, Battle of Chinsura, and Battle of Buxar during his tenure. 

 
 
 

 
 
Lord Cornwallis (1786-93)

 
 
 
Introduced Civil Services in our country.

 
Established lower courts and appellate courts.

 
First-person to codify laws in 1793.

 
Introduced permanent Settlement in Bengal 

 
He is also called the father of civil service in India.

questions.question: During whose reign Mughal painting reached its highest level?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option __**2**__, i.e. __**Jahangir**__.

 
• Due to **Jahangir’s inclination towards art**, it was during his reign that Mughal painting reached its highest level.
 
• Mughal paintings were greatly influenced by the** miniature, Persian style of painting.**
 
• Jahangir had a good eye for art and encouraged the incorporation of the** European painting style.**
 
• Many great painters like Abul Hasan, Daswant, Mansoor and Basawan were patronized by Jahangir.

questions.question: Development of Laterite soil is the result of which of the following?
questions.solution:
• Laterite soil is formed as a result of the leaching process due to heavy rainfall.
 
• Leaching is a naturally occurring process in which the soluble substances are lost from the top layer of the soil due to precipitation. These particles travel downwards and get deposited in the lower layers.
 
• Laterite soil is found in the tropical and subtropical regions and is rich in aluminum and iron.

questions.question: Where do we find the ideals of Indian democracy in the Constitution?
questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

A constitution is a **written document** that contains a set of rules for the government. It defines the fundamental political principles, and establishing the structure, procedures, powers and duties of the government. 

__
 
• The **ideals of democracy are present in the Preamble__** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Preamble proclaims India as Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, and Republican nation.
 
• The Preamble is a brief statement that gives an introduction to the Indian Constitution.

questions.question: Who was the first Chairman of Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution:

questions.question: What is the processor that performs arithmetical and logical operations called?
questions.solution:
• A part of the central processing unit(CPU), the Arithmetic Logic Unit(ALU) is the processor that performs arithmetical and logical operations.
 
• The input for ALU includes the operand(data on which the operation is to be performed) and the code which indicates which operation has to be performed on the given data.
 
• Based on the input, the ALU performs the operation on binary numbers.

questions.question: Who won the first medal for India at the Rio Olympics?

questions.question: Who developed the first polio vaccine?
questions.solution:
__

• It was an attenuated type of vaccine and was given by injection.
 
• The first oral polio vaccine came into use in 1961 and was developed by Albert Sabin.

questions.question: Which is the deep water port being constructed in Pakistan by China?
questions.solution:
• Gwadar is the deep water port which is being developed by China in Pakistan as part of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor(CPEC) plan.
 
• This plan aims to improve and modernize Pakistani infrastructure and strengthen the economy.
